+def line_rows(start, points, dt=0.05, speed=0.10):
+    """Sample piecewise XYZ path at constant time and conservative speed."""
+    out=[]; p=np.array(start, dtype=float)

+        dest=np.array(dest, dtype=float)
+        n=max(1, int(math.ceil(np.linalg.norm(dest-p)/(speed*dt))))

+def skeleton(mask):

+def neighbors(p, sk):

+    for dy in (-1,0,1):

+        if not(dx or dy): continue
+        yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
+        if yy<0 or yy>=h or xx<0 or xx>=w or not sk[yy,xx]: continue
+        if dx and dy and (sk[y,xx] or sk[yy,x]): continue
+        out.append((yy,xx))
+    return out
+
+def _dist(a,b): return math.sqrt((a[0]-b[0])**2+(a[1]-b[1])**2)
+
+def _dijkstra(src, edges, adj):
+    dist={src:0.}; prev={}; pq=[(0.,src)]
+    while pq:
+      d,u=heapq.heappop(pq)
+      if d!=dist.get(u): continue
+      for ei in adj[u]:
+        e=edges[ei]; v=e['v'] if e['u']==u else e['u']
+        nd=d+e['w']
+        if nd<dist.get(v,float('inf')):
+          dist[v]=nd; prev[v]=(u,ei); heapq.heappush(pq,(nd,v))
+    return dist,prev
+
+def _matching(odds, dists):
+    # Exact minimum-weight perfect matching by bitmask DP (few odd nodes per glyph).
+    memo={0:(0.,[])}
+    def solve(mask):
+      if mask in memo:return memo[mask]
+      i=(mask & -mask).bit_length()-1; rem=mask^(1<<i); best=(float('inf'),None)
+      jj=rem
+      while jj:
+        bit=jj&-jj; j=bit.bit_length()-1; jj^=bit

+        if v<best[0]:best=(v,ps+[(i,j)])
+      memo[mask]=best;return best

+
+def component_route(sk):

+    ys,xs=np.where(sk); pix=[(int(y),int(x)) for y,x in zip(ys,xs)]; pset=set(pix)
+    ad={p:neighbors(p,sk) for p in pix}

+    special={p for p in pix if len(ad[p])!=2}
+    node_lab={}; groups=[]
+    while special:

+    # If diagonal suppression ever splits a component, keep only the reachable portion.
+    reachable={0};todo=[0]

+def resample(route, step_px=12.0):

+    keep=np.r_[True,np.linalg.norm(np.diff(pts,axis=0),axis=1)>0]

+
+def build_routes():
